newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo experts discover rich zeolite deposits - Tanjug.
newsitem.headline: Yugo experts discover rich zeolite deposits - Tanjug.

text.p: Yugoslav geologists have discovered large zeolite mineral deposits on Mt Kopaonik in southern Serbia, Belgrade news agency Tanjug reported on Wednesday.
On-site exploration was conducted for three years by the Belgrade geological company Geozavod, Mramor cooperative from Brus and the Serbian mining and power ministry, Tanjug said.
According to findings, there are about two million tonnes of zeolite deposits in the area under research.
Experts said Mt Kopaonik had two times more zeolite ore than any other mine in the world.
Zeolite is used as an additive in fertilisers and poultry feed and in air purification filters. --Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 2224305
